anomalies.observed: C32 is populated as a 100 pF capacitor in the schematic value and SPICE deck, but its footprint, library part, datasheet and manufacturer part number all correspond to a 100 nF X7R 0603 capacitor (GRM188R72A104KA35D).
anomalies.expected: C32 is a +3V3-to-GND decoupling capacitor and should be 100 nF to match its assigned part and provide adequate rail decoupling.

evidence.quote: (comp (ref "C32") (value "100p") (footprint "Coert-Vonk:CAP X7R 100nF ±10 50V 0603 Murata") ... (field (name "PN") "GRM188R72A104KA35D") ... (description "0.1 µF ±10% 100V Ceramic Capacitor X7R 0603 (1608 Metric)")

anomalies.impact: If the value field is used for assembly, a 100 pF capacitor will be placed instead of 100 nF, reducing decoupling on the +3V3 rail. If the manufacturer part number is used, the board will still receive a 100 nF part, but the design files remain internally inconsistent and simulation does not match the intended BOM.

parsed.summary: The design files are largely consistent, but C32 has a clear value mismatch: the schematic/SPICE value is 100 pF while the assigned part, footprint, description and MPN are for 100 nF. This is a reportable wrong-value anomaly.
